pronoun possessive determiner

  • CURIE: gmeow:pronounPossessiveDeterminer
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/pronounPossessiveDeterminer
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/names
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The possessive determiner form of a pronoun set, e.g. "her", "their", "xyr".

Structure

Property shape: datatype property; gmeow:PronounSet -> rdfs:Literal; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:pronounPossessiveDeterminer from gmeow:PronounSet to rdfs:Literal when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to carry the possessive determiner form of a gmeow:PronounSet — one of the five forms that define a custom set.

Avoid when

  • Avoid confusing it with the possessive pronoun form (gmeow:pronounPossessive — 'their book' versus 'the book is theirs') and avoid filling only some of the five forms on a specifying set.

How to use

  • Set gmeow:pronounPossessiveDeterminer once per gmeow:PronounSet (functional), alongside the other four form properties when minting a custom set.

Examples

  • ex:set gmeow:pronounPossessiveDeterminer "their".
